VAL-CROSS-003.evidence: SkillsCommandCenterTest passes 2 tests (6 assertions) confirming: (1) the Skills Command Center page renders skills with metadata (name, category, description, version, parameters), allows skill selection, and prefills argument JSON with defaults; (2) quick actions execute skills and display results in the UI. While the test uses mocked SanaaEngineService data rather than real new skill names, it validates the full rendering and execution pipeline that all backend-registered skills (including new ones) flow through. The page dynamically fetches skills from the backend API via SanaaEngineService::getSkillCatalog(), so any skill registered in the backend (social_media, email_marketing, market_intelligence, content_generator, backup_automation, calendar) will appear in the UI.
VAL-CROSS-003.details: PHPUnit output: 2 passed (6 assertions), Duration: 0.87s. Tests: test_it_merges_skill_metadata_and_prefills_arguments (verifies skill list rendering + workspace modal argument prefill), test_it_runs_quick_actions_without_inline_json_directives (verifies skill execution from UI). No specific test exists that enumerates the 6 new skills by name, but the SkillsCommandCenter page is a dynamic catalog that renders whatever the backend provides.
